expected_level_description: You can: - manage large, complex, or high-risk projects - set project management standards and coach project managers - recover failing projects

You can: - lead a continual planning process in a very complex environment - plan beyond product delivery - identify dependencies in plans across services and co-ordinate delivery - coach other teams as the central point of expertise

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress

You can: - make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity - build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders - be trusted by senior risk owners as an expert in security - apply risk methodologies at the most complex levels of risk - guide others in applying risk methodologies in proportion to the risk

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
You can: - negotiate, influence or set budgets in complex environments - write or input into business cases and can communicate business-value propositions
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
